# Structured decisions by year

[简体中文](../../../system-one/catalog/by-year.md) · English

Papers are newest first by arXiv v1. Jev is a continually updated hosted product and appears separately, without an invented paper date.

## 2026

- **2026-10-21** — [When Multiple Choices Are Correct](../../../system-one/2610.29217-jev-multicorrect/README-en.md): Distinguish normalized categorical shares from independently queried binary correctness probabilities; the former are not calibrated binary confidence. The paper studies Jev, Luna and Gemini. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- **2026-10-20** — [Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision](../../../multimodal-models/2610.28435-system-one-rerank/README-en.md): Instead of generating a ranked list or training a separate pointwise reranker, the model scores each candidate by reading the probability of its letter label at the first answer position. The readout follows setwise and FIRST-style methods; the paper tests how this approach works zero-shot on images and visual documents, and whether text-only decision tuning transfers to visual reranking. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- **2026-10-16** — [Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking](../../../foundation-models/2610.23346-jev-portuguese-ir/README-en.md): On Quati it separately uses an independent Noul probability that each document directly answers the query, gathers every batch, and sorts the results. Candidates do not compete in a single Choice, probabilities are not mixed with BM25 scores, and there is no trained calibrator. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- **2026-10-15** — [Prism-1](../../../foundation-models/2610.22066-prism-1/README-en.md): A softmax combines independent scores. Softmax alone cannot guarantee this without attention isolation and position reset. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- **2026-01-19** — [Calibration-Aware Reinforcement Learning](../../../post-training/2601.13284-calibration-aware-rl/README-en.md): The paper adjusts decision-token probabilities directly to reduce ECE without sacrificing accuracy. The repository reports accuracy alongside Brier score and ECE, fits temperature only on validation, and forbids test-set tuning.

## 2025

- **2025-08-11** — [GLiClass](../../../foundation-models/2508.07662-gliclass/README-en.md): This avoids unstable parsing of generative LLM outputs and separate cross-encoder inference on each text–label pair. The repository retains the defining mechanisms: candidate content affects scores, and one normalization produces a distribution over all candidates.
- **2025-07-22** — [RLCR](../../../post-training/2507.16806-rlcr/README-en.md): RLCR predicts both an answer and its confidence and adds a bounded proper scoring rule so honest probabilities maximize expected reward. The local baseline minimizes multiclass Brier over the full candidate distribution.
